description: This file contains the Hibernate implementation of the VisitDAO interface, providing database operations for Visit entities in the OpenMRS system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and querying Visit-related data with criteria-based filtering.

classes.name: HibernateVisitDAO
classes.description: Hibernate-specific implementation of VisitDAO interface, providing database access methods for Visit data.

methods.name: getAllVisitTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all visitor types, with optional inclusion of retired types.

methods.name: getVisitType
methods.description: Fetches a VisitType by its ID.

methods.name: getVisitTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a VisitType by its UUID.

methods.name: getVisitTypes
methods.description: Retrieves visit types matching a fuzzy search pattern.

methods.name: saveVisitType
methods.description: Saves or updates a VisitType entity.

methods.name: purgeVisitType
methods.description: Deletes a VisitType.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Retrieves a Visit by its ID.

methods.name: getVisitByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Visit by its UUID.

methods.name: saveVisit
methods.description: Saves or updates a Visit entity.

methods.name: deleteVisit
methods.description: Deletes a Visit.

methods.name: getVisits
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Visits based on various filter criteria.

methods.name: getVisits (via VisitSearchCriteria)
methods.description: Retrieves Visits based on complex search criteria.

methods.name: getAllVisitAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all VisitAttributeType entities.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a VisitAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a VisitAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a VisitAttributeType.

methods.name: deleteVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a VisitAttributeType.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a VisitAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getNextVisit
methods.description: Fetches the next Visit after a given Visit, optionally filtered by VisitTypes and maximum start date.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory.

methods.name: getCurrentSession
methods.description: Gets the current Hibernate Session.
